_comment: How this venue was built, so it can be built again. Written by scripts/build-venue.mjs on every build; replayed with "npm run venues:rebuild -- six-flags-magic-mountain". "box" is the bounding box before "pad" was applied to it, which is why a venue asked for by place name, by box or by a point and a radius all record the same field. Edit it by hand if you like — a rebuild reads whatever is here.
